I read hq-mode's working-style page first. The approved run plan allows at most 32G of memory
per job, and the merge step needs about 200G, so this job is outside the plan. A job outside
the plan goes back on the always-pause list, and "going to bed" does not change that.

Everything else is ready tonight: the merge script is written in the work folder and the shard
list is checked. Nothing has been submitted.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=merge
#SBATCH --partition=cpu
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=240G
#SBATCH --time=06:00:00
#SBATCH --output=logs/merge_%j.out
pixi run python merge.py --shards shards/ --out merged/
```

Proposed revised run plan, for your yes:

- Most memory per job: 32G for the download jobs, 240G for this one merge job.
